theme_central: A rhythmic hammering: "Woe that Day to the deniers!" — repeated ten times, more than any other refrain in the Qur'an, after every proof of Allah's power and justice.
sources_note: Precisely sourced structure (ayahguide.com, Reflection & Tadabbur): 1-7, 12-15, 16-28, 45-50; refrain confirmed repeated ten times.

branches.title: Cosmic oaths
branches.resume: Oaths by the successive envoys, building rising tension toward the promised event.

children.t: Oaths by the successive envoys, the promised event under way

branches.title: The Day of Sorting
branches.resume: Stars erased, sky split, mountains crushed to powder; first refrain: "Woe that Day to the deniers!"

children.t: The Day of Sorting appointed, first refrain against the deniers

branches.title: The proofs
branches.resume: Destruction of the ancient deniers, creation from a lowly fluid, stable earth, sweet water.

children.t: Destruction of the ancients, human creation, stable earth, sweet water — repeated proofs

branches.title: Hell and Paradise contrasted
branches.resume: A shadow with three branches offering no protection, sparks like castles; gardens and springs for the pious.

children.t: Shadow with three branches, sparks like castles for the deniers
Gardens and springs for the pious, a day when none speaks without permission

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Invitation to the pious to eat and drink pleasantly; final refrains addressed directly to the deniers.

children.t: Reward of the pious, final refrains addressed to the deniers
